original_assignment.objective: Determine which chemical sustainability claims the supplied equation/pathway panel supports. Inspect original declarations, obtain applicable saved native accounting results, and iteratively resolve or retain atom/charge residuals, explicit electron accounting, carrier regeneration and matching-condition weighted energetics. Distinguish balanced equations from physiological direction, favorable aggregate energy from favorable or coupled steps, and declared chemistry from protein activity. Preserve specific unresolved prerequisites and any separate dataset leads for the parent.
original_assignment.investigation_focus: Supplied declared chemical equation/pathway panel; inspect supplied sources to identify its actual operands and distinguish the separate reaction-measurement/resource dataset. Preserve synthetic origin, original species identities and shared representations. Obtain applicable native accounting components and qualify their scientific interpretation without combining them with experimental ratio or resource-model values.
